# units/ns

> n ns: nanoseconds: the unit durations are counted in, as nanoseconds.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/ns.pkg)

```
print 250 ns   // 250
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 ns` is `2 * (3 ns)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} ns -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
